summary.motive: Manufacture guaranteed interior penetration against standard 5-man/6-man slide pass protections using a synchronized A-gap cross-dog blitz.
summary.keyDefender: WILL (Delayed A-gap blitzer) & MIKE (Point-of-attack pick blitzer)
summary.whyItWorks: The interior DT slants widen the offensive guards while MIKE consumes the Center, leaving the looping WILL with a direct line to the quarterback under 2.2 seconds.
summary.failureMode: Screen passes designed to exploit the aggressive interior rush, or max-protect 7-man schemes with dual RB/TE chips.

beats.title: Base Look Masking 5-Man Pressure
beats.text: Saleh disguises the blitz out of standard 4-3 Over spacing. The offense expects a 4-man rush with zone drops behind it.

beats.title: Cross-Dog Stunt Ignites
beats.text: At the snap, NT and 3T slant into B-gaps. MIKE charges the Center directly, drawing the slide block and clearing a wide gap behind him.

beats.title: Will Loops Unblocked into A-Gap
beats.text: WILL wraps tightly around MIKE’s back, exploding through the vacated A-gap completely untouched as the RB is caught on the wrong side of the formation.

beats.title: Underneath Hot Windows Suffocated
beats.text: While WILL hits the QB, SAM and SS drop into the exact slant/hitch windows where a hot throw would go, resulting in an immediate drive-killing sack.

relations.tell: Mike & Will sprint downhill at snap to cross interior gaps instead of reading backfield run flow
